meta.title: Maiko Snow Resort
meta.description: ~1 min from Shiozawa-Ishiuchi IC — 26 courses and 6,000 m runs for families. ~30 min by car or bus from Echigo-Yuzawa Station, Spa Maiko onsen, and local food loops.

transit.title:
From Echigo-Yuzawa,
~30 min by car or bus.
transit.lead: ~20–30 minutes by free shuttle from JR Echigo-Yuzawa Station — pair with the Joetsu Shinkansen for day-trip snow. By car, ~1 minute from Kan-Etsu Shiozawa-Ishiuchi IC, minimizing snowy-road stress.
transit.imgAlt: Snowy Echigo-Yuzawa Station and shuttle bus — winter trip to Maiko Snow Resort

primary.title: 26 courses · 6,000 m big resort
primary.lead: 196 ha with 80% beginner–intermediate terrain across Maiko, Nagamine, and Okusoechi zones — gentle wide slopes and the 6,000 m Ranran long cruise. IC-adjacent convenience makes it a Tokyo-area family staple.
primary.imgAlt: Maiko Snow Resort gentle slopes and long runs — Minamiuonuma mountain panorama

secondary.title: After skiing, Spa Maiko
secondary.lead: Spa Maiko inside Maiko Kogen Hotel plus Majidon rice-bowl shops at the base and Ishiuchi onsen villages — easy food and bath loops beyond the slopes.

onsen.title:
Spa Maiko &
Minamiuonuma baths
onsen.lead: From slope-side day baths to Hatsukaishi Onsen and Rokujomachi Yuraria — stitch recovery and area touring into one snow day.
onsen.whisper: Confirm day-use rules and hours on each facility's official site before visiting.
onsen.imgAlt: Spa Maiko — hot spring with snowy mountain view

spa-maiko.title: Spa Maiko (Maiko Kogen Hotel)
spa-maiko.lead: 2056-108 Maiko, Minamiuonuma, Niigata. Day-use baths inside Maiko Kogen Hotel — immediate post-ski recovery. TEL 025-783-3511 (verify).

hatsukaishi.title: Hatsukaishi Onsen (Ishiuchi Young Palnas)
hatsukaishi.lead: 946 Tsuchido, Ishiuchi, Minamiuonuma. Legacy Ishiuchi onsen village — confirm day-use fees and hours. TEL 025-783-7888.

yuraria.title: Rokujomachi Onsen Yuraria
yuraria.lead: 105-1 Rokujomachi, Minamiuonuma. Day-use facility in Rokujomachi — car access typical. TEL 025-773-3450 (verify).

tanashoku.title: Tanashoku
tanashoku.lead: 2056-151 Maiko, Minamiuonuma. Local Majidon campaign diner — hearty rice and regional ingredients. TEL 025-783-2265. https://tanasyoku.com/
tanashoku.imgAlt: Tanashoku Majidon — popular base diner near Maiko

iiho.title: Restaurant IIHO
iiho.lead: 2056-108 Maiko (Maiko zone). On-slope Majidon participant — check official app for lunch crowds. TEL 025-783-4100 (resort main line).

nearbyFood.pairingLead: Morning: Maiko zone from IC → lunch: IIHO slope food → afternoon: Ranran long run → evening: Spa Maiko → night: Tanashoku Majidon → Echigo-Yuzawa Station.

ic-access.title: ~1 min from Shiozawa-Ishiuchi IC
ic-access.body: Exit Kan-Etsu Expressway and you're there — the biggest reassurance for urban drivers on snowy roads. A 2,000-space day-trip center and hotel-linked Maiko zone deliver unmatched short access.

longrun.title: 6,000 m Ranran long run
longrun.body: Nagamine's signature cruise — 6,000 m at gentle 6–7° average pitch so beginners enjoy summit views. Okusoechi adds Guigui, Gungan, and off-piste zones for stronger riders.

gastro.title: Majidon & slope dining
gastro.body: Tanashoku and on-slope IIHO join the Minamiuonuma Majidon campaign — high-rated slope food with Koshihikari rice. Repeat visits come from ski-plus-food-plus-rest totals, not runs alone.
